title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and maintain mask-wearing behavior over time under social influence, information campaigns, policy mandates, enforcement, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask-wearing among their social network and update their likelihood to adopt based on peer behavior relative to their adoption_threshold.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and government enforcement agents check compliance; noncompliant individuals may be denied entry or fined with a probability based on enforcement_strictness and enforcement_capacity.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media and government broadcast messages that affect individuals' risk_perception and trust_in_authority; misinformation can counteract official guidance.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to buy masks from retailers; success depends on inventory_level, price, and rationing_policy; subsidies reduce effective price.

interactions.name: location_entry
interactions.description: Individuals move to locations according to mobility patterns; admission may require masks depending on mask_policy; this influences observed social norms.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: Exogenous or location-specific prevalence signals influence individual risk_perception and subsequent adoption decisions.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks at each time step and averaged over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_70_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall mask adoption first reaches or exceeds 70%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_post_mandate
metrics.description: Average mask adoption rate during a window after a mandate ends, indicating habit formation.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference or ratio of adoption rates between high- and low-income groups.

metrics.name: enforcement_events
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement interactions (warnings, denials, fines) issued during the simulation.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days with retailer stockouts where at least one retailer inventory_level is zero when demand exists.

metrics.name: average_cost_per_person
metrics.description: Mean per-capita cost including mask purchases and fines net of subsidies.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate over the simulation period.

metrics.name: adoption_volatility
metrics.description: Temporal variability of adoption, e.g., standard deviation of adoption rate over time.
